rubric.label: Compliance
rubric.purpose: Follows the repository's contribution rules: predicts whether the PR can be merged.

rubric.label: Security & Privacy
rubric.purpose: Safe to merge and run: no secrets, no dangerous code, sound AI-specific safety.

rubric.label: Functionality & Reproducibility
rubric.purpose: Does what it claims and installs and runs on someone else's machine.

rubric.label: AI-Native
rubric.purpose: How deeply and how well AI is engineered in, beyond a thin wrapper around one prompt.

rubric.label: Docs & Developer Experience
rubric.purpose: A newcomer can understand, set up and use it within five minutes.

rubric.label: Innovation & Impact
rubric.purpose: Original and useful. Kept at a low weight because it is subjective.
